dl.meta.title: Download Avistry
dl.meta.description: Download Avistry for free: VCC, .unitypackage or Git URL, every version with its checksum and download count.
dl.title: Get Avistry.
dl.lead: Free and open source. VCC is the easiest way, and it keeps Avistry up to date.
dl.none: The version list is not ready yet. Every version is on GitHub Releases.
dl.need.1.b: The version VRChat uses, set up through the VRChat Creator Companion.
dl.need.2.b: Any VRChat avatar. Poiyomi and lilToon are supported; neither is required.
dl.need.3.b: No account and no tracking. It runs in the Editor and adds nothing to your upload.
trust.title: Check it before you install
install.vcc.s1: Select Get it in VCC. If nothing happens, copy the listing URL below and add it in VCC under Settings > Packages > Add Repository.
install.vcc.s2: Open your avatar project in VCC, go to Manage Project and select + next to Avistry.
install.open: In Unity, open Tools > Avistry > Textures.
install.unity.s1: Download the .unitypackage from the button above or from GitHub Releases.
install.unity.s2: With your project open, drag the file into the Project window, or choose Assets > Import Package > Custom Package. Then select Import.
install.git.s1: In Unity, open Window > Package Manager.
install.git.s2: Select +, choose Add package from git URL and paste the URL below.
install.vcchelp: VCC did not open? Copy the listing URL and add it under Settings > Packages > Add Repository.
dl.dev.lead2: Missing a tool? Build it with your AI assistant and share it with everyone.
dl.dev.1.b2: Clone it, or download it as a .zip.
dl.dev.2.b2: Use Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Cursor if you like. The contributing guide has the rules: read the code, try it in Unity and keep it in the spirit of Avistry.
dl.dev.3.b2: Open a pull request. We test every one and ship it in a normal version.
